item.title: Does T-Bank's private ecosystem hit a state data wall?
item.description: T-Tech is spending billions on acquisitions, but its ecosystem strategy clashes with the poor quality of state data and biometric checks.

item.title: The Finance Ministry shifts budget protection from oil to bank deposits
item.description: Russia's new three-year budget shifts the fiscal burden from volatile oil revenue to progressive income taxes, bank deposits and retail investments.

item.title: Why the White House brought back Nvidia’s chief for a trillion dollars
item.description: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang returns as CEO after White House intervention, exposing systemic governance risks and Wall Street's heavy dependence on one man.

item.title: Russian diesel deal hits burnt-out refineries
item.description: Refinery strikes and legal barriers disrupt Russia's diesel deal with the US, forcing shipowners out and driving fiscal pressure onto domestic miners.

item.title: Why European diplomats are attending talks uninvited
item.description: European officials linger in Abu Dhabi corridors while major powers discuss continental security and strikes on energy infrastructure escalate.

item.title: A sharp reduction in subsidies forces banks to return borrowers to the market
item.description: October family mortgage lending in Russia fell 77% after subsidy cuts. With market rates at 19%, buyers and businesses face a high-rate environment.

item.title: Why T-Technologies is buying Russia’s main property portal
item.description: T-Technologies is bidding for Cian to capture Russia's home buyers before they compare mortgage rates. Control over property search brings rich returns.

item.title: Did Trump’s inflation fight cost the Republicans both houses of Congress?
item.description: The Democratic Party has won control of both houses of the US Congress, as voters punish the Trump administration for high inflation and rising living costs.

item.title: Has Wall Street turned the American stockmarket into a giant casino?
item.description: Wall Street's reliance on extreme leverage has decoupled stock prices from fundamentals, creating a casino-like environment despite strong US GDP growth.

item.title: State seizes a tenth of private server capacity
item.description: Russia forces private data centres to set aside 10% of capacity for state use, shifting war risks onto commercial IT operators with FSB oversight.
